name.ja: 周期Taylor–Green渦：速度・散逸・発散
name.en: Periodic Taylor–Green vortex: velocity, decay and divergence

scope.ja: 既存の2次元MAC投影法・中心対流項・明示SSPRK2を使用。16²/32²/64²で解析的減衰渦と比較し、最細格子はCFL半減でも確認。
scope.en: Use existing two-dimensional MAC projection, centered convection and explicit SSPRK2. Compare analytic decaying vortex on 16²/32²/64² grids and halve CFL on the finest grid.

assumptions.ja: 単位密度、[0,2π)²、ν=0.1、T=0.5。u₀=sin x cos y、v₀=−cos x sin y。既存ソルバーの移流・拡散安定性に基づくCFL=0.2、時間感度検査は0.1。
assumptions.en: Unit density, [0,2*pi)², nu=0.1 and T=0.5. u0=sin(x)cos(y), v0=-cos(x)sin(y). CFL=0.2 uses the solver's combined advection/diffusion stability estimate; temporal sensitivity uses 0.1.

units.ja: 無次元。速度振幅1、座標周期2π、粘性νの次元は長さ²/時間。圧力は単位密度での比圧力。平均運動エネルギーは〈u²+v²〉/2。
units.en: Nondimensional velocity amplitude one and coordinate period 2*pi; viscosity has length²/time units. Pressure is kinematic pressure at unit density. Mean kinetic energy is <u²+v²>/2.

boundaries.ja: 2方向周期、圧力平均0。u・vは異なるMAC面、圧力はセル中心。Poissonは連続k²ではなく離散DG記号を逆演算。
boundaries.en: Periodic in both axes, zero-mean pressure. u/v occupy different MAC faces and pressure cell centers. Poisson inverts the discrete DG symbol, not continuum k².

description.ja: CSVは(i,j)をC順に並べ、u面・v面・圧力中心それぞれの座標、数値解と解析解を別列に保存。MAC速度を同じ位置の成分と誤解しない。JSONにエネルギー履歴と時間感度を保存。
description.en: CSV uses C-order (i,j) rows with separate coordinates and numerical/analytic values for u faces, v faces and pressure centers; the components are not collocated. JSON includes energy histories and temporal sensitivity.

description.ja: u=sin x cos y e^(−2νt)、v=−cos x sin y e^(−2νt)、p=(cos2x+cos2y)e^(−4νt)/4。平均運動エネルギーはe^(−4νt)/4。
description.en: u=sin(x)cos(y)e^(-2nu*t), v=-cos(x)sin(y)e^(-2nu*t), p=(cos(2x)+cos(2y))e^(-4nu*t)/4; mean kinetic energy e^(-4nu*t)/4.

description.ja: 既存投影法項目のChorin文献。今回のMAC配置とSSPRK2の具体形は公開実装に固定。
description.en: Chorin reference already cited by the projection-method record; MAC placement and SSPRK2 details are fixed by the released implementation.

failure_scope.ja: 非正粘性・終端時刻、CFL範囲外、倍増でない格子を拒否。安定時間刻みも変わる格子細分化は空間のみの次数証明ではない。固定格子のCFL半減は時間感度であり厳密誤差上界ではない。壁境界・乱流・任意Reynolds数への検証ではない。
failure_scope.en: Reject nonpositive viscosity/final time, invalid CFL and nondoubling grids. Grid refinement also changes the stable time step and is not a pure spatial-order proof. Fixed-grid CFL reduction measures sensitivity, not a rigorous error bound. No validation of walls, turbulence or arbitrary Reynolds number.

reference_notes.ja: CSVは(i,j)をC順に並べ、u面・v面・圧力中心それぞれの座標、数値解と解析解を別列に保存。MAC速度を同じ位置の成分と誤解しない。JSONにエネルギー履歴と時間感度を保存。
reference_notes.en: CSV uses C-order (i,j) rows with separate coordinates and numerical/analytic values for u faces, v faces and pressure centers; the components are not collocated. JSON includes energy histories and temporal sensitivity.

scope.ja: 自作コードはMIT。入力・数値データ・図・本文はサイトの個別条件に従います。この台帳は利用許諾を拡大しません。
scope.en: Original code is MIT. Inputs, numerical data, figures and prose retain the site’s item-specific terms. This registry does not expand reuse permissions.

description.ja: 細格子の速度を各MAC座標で解析解と比較。
description.en: Compare finest-grid velocity with the analytic solution at its MAC locations.

description.ja: 空間・安定時間刻みを共に細分化した速度の観測次数。
description.en: Observed velocity order under combined spatial/stable-time-step refinement.

description.ja: 全時間履歴で離散発散を確認。
description.en: Check discrete divergence over the whole time history.

description.ja: 解析的平均運動エネルギーの減衰と比較。
description.en: Compare with analytic mean kinetic-energy decay.

description.ja: 粘性系での時間履歴の運動エネルギー増加を検出。
description.en: Detect kinetic-energy increases in the viscous time history.

description.ja: 同じ細格子でCFLを半分にした変化が元の解析解誤差の10%以下。誤差上界ではない。
description.en: At fixed finest grid, halving CFL changes velocity by at most 10% of the original analytic error; not an error bound.

description.ja: 指定した終端時刻に到達。

outcome.ja: 周期渦の速度と粘性エネルギー減衰を解析解と比べ、離散発散・圧力ゲージ・格子と時間刻みへの依存を確認する。
outcome.en: Compare periodic-vortex velocity and viscous energy decay with analytic references; inspect discrete divergence, pressure gauge and space/time sensitivity.

note.ja: [0,2π)²周期、t=0.5、16/32/64格子のMAC圧力射影。保存すべき定数エネルギーではなく粘性減衰を調べる。空間と安定刻みの同時細分化と、同一格子の刻み感度を区別する。
note.en: Periodic [0,2π)², t=0.5, MAC pressure projection on 16/32/64 grids. Check viscous decay rather than constant energy. Combined space/stable-step refinement is separated from fixed-grid time-step sensitivity.
